answer: Identity-Diversity Kernel: each identity must embed a distinct hardware root whose attestation is checked against a shared kernel of known-fraudulent device fingerprints. Registration also requires a marble: one verifiable, non-replayable proof-of-work token scoped to that root, and a trellis of cross-links to two existing identities whose own link slots are consumed. Cloning N identities costs N roots plus N works plus 2N consumed link slots; forged links collapse both the clone and its sponsors.
